description: Use this skill to run an end-to-end RFQ (Request for Quotation) pipeline for a procurement/sourcing operation: intake from email or Telegram, Obsidian-vault storage, pricing calculation, supplier quote comparison, and confirmed-send drafting. Trigger on the wake phrase "T, we live?", on inbound RFQ

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
